title: Sunday · Dog Night, 2017
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: Eighteen years, the third with the pup. The alley, the sign with five letters dark, the pup at the dumpster where the first dog's nose went. The man's hand on him in the last tier.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the bowling sign over the alley at night with five of its letters dark.

image.prompt: a neon bowling alley sign above a rainy alley at night with five of its letters dark, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Five

panels.composition: Tier 2: the pup's nose to the dumpster's corner, the man waiting with the leash slack.

image.prompt: a small three-legged dog sniffing a dumpster's corner in a rainy alley while a man waits with a slack leash, watercolor

panels.name: Corner

panels.composition: Tier 3: the two of them under the sign from behind, his hand on the pup's back.

image.prompt: a man and a small three-legged dog from behind beneath a mostly dark neon sign, his hand resting on the dog's back, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Hand

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk
